what_this_is: The Phase 2 preregistration lock: target definition, feature set, and model spec, fixed before the holdout is touched. Validation split is referenced, not re-declared -- it was already fixed at Phase 1 step 1.
what_this_is_not: Not a result, not Phase 3's one real holdout run, and not permission to compute anything against the holdout. It constrains what that later, separate, explicitly-authorized run may do; it performs none.

governing_documents.which_decisions: target definition, feature set, model specification -- the three items GST_HYP04_ANALYSIS_LOCK_v1.0.json's own scope.does_not_fix names

target_definition.formula: RVar(h) = (1/h) * sum_{i=1..h} r_i^2 over [t+1, t+h]; RVar_ref = (1/20) * sum r_i^2 over the trailing 20 sessions ending at the anchor's earnings date; raw = log(RVar(h)) - log(RVar_ref); target = raw - earnings_cycle_baseline(peer, days_to_own_earnings)
target_definition.residualization: REQUIRED, not optional -- section 3.2's own definition subtracts earnings_cycle_baseline unconditionally. Phase 1's unresidualized_sensitivity treatment was an ad hoc diagnostic aid for the BB coverage question, never a preregistered alternate spec, and is not carried forward here.
target_definition.pre_earnings_history_exclusion: an observation before a peer's own first recorded earnings release is excluded from both baseline fitting and application, never extrapolated backward. Fixed in target.py while scoping this lock -- see EarningsCycleBaseline.has_earnings_history_at -- and pinned here as part of the locked spec, not a separate footnote.

deferred_candidates.name: peer_anchor_correlation_beta
deferred_candidates.reason: requires new computation over historical peer/anchor return series; nothing in the current inference layer produces it

deferred_candidates.name: relationship_type
deferred_candidates.reason: the data already exists on every curated linkage edge (CuratedEdge.relationship_type) and would be cheap to read, but wiring it into the regression -- dummy or interaction terms -- is unexercised code with no end-to-end run behind it; deferred rather than locking a path that has never actually run

deferred_candidates.name: peer_coverage_thinness_proxy
deferred_candidates.reason: needs GST/GDELT infrastructure integration; nothing in hyp04_supply_chain_hedge currently touches that data source

feature_set.deviation_from_plan: plan section 3.4 names five candidate features; only the two above are implemented and locked. The other three are named as a stated, documented deviation -- not silently dropped, not built for this lock.

model_spec.estimator: local projections with CR2 clustered standard errors, Satterthwaite degrees of freedom, and max-T permutation multiplicity correction -- fixed by the D1-D10 analysis lock and referenced here, not restated

smoke_test: validate_phase2_lock() re-runs the locked pipeline over the EXPLORATION set only and confirms it reproduces this lock's own declared feature set, cluster key, and hash pins -- a tamper/drift check, never a result, and it never touches the holdout.
opens_no_gate: This is a computed Phase 2 lock, not a freeze, not a registry change, not a linkage ratification. It moves no gate condition, whatever the gate reads at the moment this file is read.
